components.html:
Q. What is Acme Air Flight?

Acme Air brings destination inspiration and flight planning together in one simple place. This interactive preview lets you explore routes and plan your next adventure.
components.css: .ds-faq{border:1px solid #eceff1;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--color-ink,#0a0a0a);font-family:var(--font-sans,'Manrope',sans-serif)}.ds-question+.ds-question{border-top:1px solid #e9ecef}.ds-question summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:68px;padding:19px 23px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-question summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-question summary:hover{background:#f8fbfc}.ds-question summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #367d8e;outline-offset:5px}.ds-question summary svg{flex-shrink:0;transition:transform 180ms}.ds-question[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-question>p{margin:0;padding:0 50px 22px 23px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;color:#51585a}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-question summary{padding:18px 16px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}.ds-question>p{padding:0 20px 20px 16px;font-size:13px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-question summary svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Acme Air pairs photographic clouds and a large isolated passenger airplane with neutral sans-serif lettering, black controls, and gently rounded destination photography. This phrase describes the built OWN-WORLD contract; it introduces no new visual direction. The user-provided screenshot pins the palette, composition, Acme Air name, and spacious character.

The React/TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4 frontend uses custom CSS for its visual identity and utility classes for flex/grid composition. Local imagery closely matches the reference rather than reproducing its exact assets; provenance lives in ASSETS.md. This record follows the shipped source, with the supplied desktop/mobile captures as composition evidence. The reported finish verdict is ship at two-fix scope: cloud contrast and text contrast resolved.
keyCharacteristics: Muted cyan photographic atmosphere fading into white.
Heavy Manrope headlines, quiet supporting text, and black actions.
Rounded photographic tiles and pale, mostly flat information panels.
Generous desktop spacing that compresses into stacked mobile sections.

rules.name: The Contrast Separation Rule
rules.body: Keep the built dark text on pale surfaces and white labels over darkened destination images; cloud photography remains softened behind copy.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep routes and testimonials flat at rest; reserve the existing diffuse shadows for overlays and the airplane.

dos: Do preserve the screenshot-pinned cyan clouds, white canvas, black actions, and spacious composition.
Do use the actual Manrope hierarchy and responsive overrides recorded here.
Do retain the softened cloud layers, dark supporting text, destination scrims, and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep local imagery provenance in ASSETS.md and demo interactions explicit.
donts: Don't replace the built atmosphere or section composition with a new visual direction.
Don't add ambient shadows to flat route or testimonial cards.
Don't treat illustrative photography, testimonials, or local confirmations as verified locations, customer evidence, or live bookings.
Don't promote the two reference-specific tagline pills into a reusable eyebrow or kicker system.
